product_overview: A small web app providing local email/password authentication: users can register, sign in, view a protected dashboard with basic account/session counts, and log out. Registration hashes passwords and enforces validation including duplicate-email rejection.
core_goals: Allow new users to create an account with name, email, and password using client-facing forms.
Validate inputs (name length, email format, password length) and surface clear errors for invalid or duplicate data.
Hash and persist user passwords securely on account creation.
Authenticate existing users and maintain session state to protect the dashboard route.
Provide a logout flow that ends the session and prevents access to protected routes.

features.name: Landing Navigation
features.description: Public landing page that directs unauthenticated users to registration or login and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See options to create an account or sign in -> Choose to create an account -> Navigate to /register
Navigate to / -> See options to create an account or sign in -> Choose to sign in -> Navigate to /login
Navigate to / while authenticated -> Be redirected to /dashboard

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new local account by providing name, email, and password; client validates inputs and server-side logic rejects duplicate emails and stores hashed passwords, then redirects to dashboard on success.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill name with at least 2 characters -> Fill email with a valid email address -> Fill password with at least 6 characters -> Submit registration form -> Be redirected to /dashboard

Navigate to /register -> Fill name with 1 character -> Fill email with a valid email address -> Fill password with at least 6 characters -> Submit registration form -> See validation error for short name

Navigate to /register -> Fill name with valid value -> Fill email with invalid-format value -> Fill password with valid value -> Submit registration form -> See validation error for invalid email format

Navigate to /register -> Fill name with valid value -> Fill email that already exists in the system -> Fill password with valid value -> Submit registration form -> See error indicating email already in use
Navigate to /register -> Fill name with valid value -> Fill email with valid value -> Fill password with fewer than 6 characters -> Submit registration form -> See validation error for short password

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate existing users with email and password and redirect to the dashboard on successful authentication; surface errors for invalid input or credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email with registered email -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> Be redirected to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email with invalid-format value -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> See validation error for invalid email format
Navigate to /login -> Fill email with registered email -> Leave password empty -> Submit login form -> See validation error for missing password
Navigate to /login -> Fill email with registered email -> Fill password with incorrect value -> Submit login form -> See error for invalid credentials

features.name: Protected Dashboard
features.description: A server-protected page showing the current user's name/email plus aggregate counts for total users and active sessions; only accessible while authenticated.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard while authenticated -> See greeting that includes current user name and email -> See total user count -> See active session count
Navigate to /dashboard while not authenticated -> Be redirected to /login

features.name: Logout
features.description: End the authenticated session and return the user to the public login, preventing further access to protected pages until re-authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard while authenticated -> Trigger logout action -> Be redirected to /login -> Attempt to navigate to /dashboard -> Be redirected to /login
Navigate to /dashboard while not authenticated -> No access granted and be redirected to /login

routes.description: Landing page with navigation to registration and login, redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
Sign-in page for existing users using email and password.
Registration page for creating a new local account.
Protected dashboard showing the current user, user count, active sessions, and logout.

features.name: Landing Navigation
features.description: The home page advertises the auth flow and routes users to register or sign in.
user_interactions: Open the home page.
Click Create account to go to registration.
Click Sign in to go to login.

features.name: User Registration
features.description: New users can register with name, email, and password and are redirected to the dashboard after account creation.
user_interactions: Open the registration page.
Fill the name field with at least 2 characters.
Fill the email field with a valid email address.
Fill the password field with at least 6 characters.
Click Create account to submit the form.
See validation errors for short name, invalid email, short password, or duplicate email.
Get redirected to the dashboard on success.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Existing users can sign in with stored credentials and are redirected to the dashboard on success.
user_interactions: Open the login page.
Fill the email field.
Fill the password field.
Click Sign in to submit the form.
See an error for invalid email format, missing password, or invalid credentials.
Get redirected to the dashboard on success.

features.name: Protected Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users can view a protected dashboard with account and session information.
user_interactions: Navigate to the dashboard while authenticated.
See the greeting with the current user name and email.
View total user count.
View active session count.

features.name: Logout
features.description: Authenticated users can end their session and are redirected back to login.
user_interactions: Click Log out from the dashboard.
Get redirected to the login page.
Lose access to the protected dashboard until logging in again.

known_limitations.issue: Authentication uses Next.js server actions rather than public REST endpoints.
known_limitations.impact: Test automation must interact through the UI forms instead of calling standalone auth APIs.

known_limitations.issue: Dashboard content is read-only and only exposes aggregate counts plus logout.
known_limitations.impact: Post-login test coverage is limited to visibility and session access checks.
